messages:
maria: Triage: onboarding customer 'Bermuda' LoRA on redwood/galena-13b (4-bit). Smoke pack shows numeric corruption in invoices. Anyone available?
raj: Can you drop a failing example?
maria: Repro: 
User: "Amount owed: $4.20"
Model: "Amount: $420"
And: "Invoice total: 8,765.43 EUR" -> "876543 EUR"
sophia: Looks like tokenizer merged digit groups. Did the adapter conversion apply its BPE merges over the base vocab?
drew: Converter has a merge precedence flag; default can favor adapter merges. That would explain concatenation of ["8", ",", "765", ".", "43"] -> "876543".
raj: Quick test: apply adapter weights but force base tokenizer ids. If numbers return, it's tokenizer-only.
maria: I did that locallyresults: numeric extraction 0.96 -> 0.95 (no regression). So adapter weights are fine.
sophia: I'll run a small evalpack with tokenize_debug=true on 100 invoice-like prompts to quantify. CI: build/bermuda-lora/token-debug #9602 queued.
ci-bot: build/bermuda-lora/token-debug #9602 started by sophia.
sophia: Preliminary: 100 prompts -> 18 affected cases; accuracy 0.97 -> 0.79. Blocker.
drew: Plan: re-run conversion with --prefer-base-merges and re-quantize, add unit test for digit+comma+decimal patterns to smokepack. ETA ~2 hours. I'll open PR.
drew: PR: https://phabricator.redwood.ai/D12567 (conversion flag + test + remediation script).
raj: Canary plan after fix: 10% traffic for 12h, monitor invoice_amount_exact_match and token-diff rate; auto-roll back if accuracy < 0.9 for >5m.
sophia: I'll add an alert and a Grafana panel for the metric.
ci-bot: job #9602 finished (logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/jobs/9602).
maria: Thanks all. Tagging for follow-up once PR merges and canary completes.
